title: Master of the Guard
summary: The Master of the Guard activates paired sentries during combat.
overview: The Master of the Guard activates paired sentries during combat.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Pick up each sentry pair before it reaches the rest of the raid.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The first pair activates three seconds after combat begins.
Three further pairs activate at 50-second intervals.
Five minutes out of combat removes active sentries and restores the dormant formation.

notes: Approval E291. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
